lines.en: - We're gonna hit the beach? - Yeah, it was really great.
- Oh, thank you so much. - Yeah, oh, and so funny.
I can't tell you how much it means to me that you were here.
Are you kidding? We wouldn't have missed it.
Oh, I can't tell you how great it was to look out into the crowd
and see your face. I mean,
did you know you were mouthing the words along with me?
No, it's okay. It made me feel like a rock star.
Oh, my God. I'm your groupie.
Hey, I better not find you naked in my hotel room.
Look, I took it too far.
